question: Which manufacturing tools are linked to defects for product X?

candidates.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?t ?d WHERE { ?p a :Product . ?p :name ?p_name . ?l a :Lot . ?t a :Tool . ?d a :Defect . ?l :PRODUCED_FOR ?p . ?l :PROCESSED_WITH ?t . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . FILTER(?p_name = 'X') }
SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?p a :Product . ?p :name ?p_name . ?l a :Lot . ?t a :Tool . ?l :PRODUCED_FOR ?p . ?l :PROCESSED_WITH ?t . FILTER(?p_name = 'X') }
SELECT ?t WHERE { ?t a :Tool . ?l a :Lot . ?p a :Product . ?p :name ?p_name . ?t :PROCESSED_WITH ?l . ?l :PRODUCED_FOR ?p . FILTER(?p_name = 'X') }
SELECT DISTINCT ?d WHERE { ?p a :Product . ?p :name ?p_name . ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?l :PRODUCED_FOR ?p . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . FILTER(?p_name = 'X') }
